data.reason: Insurance brokerage and consulting that earns commissions, not an insurer underwriting and carrying policy risk.
Insurance broker earning commissions and fees, not an underwriter bearing risk.

AFG is a risk-bearing insurance carrier. It underwrites specialty commercial P&C and annuities, and it earns premiums, annuity deposits and investment income. Baldwin is an insurance broker and advisory firm. It places coverage with carriers, and its main income is commissions and fees. The two sit in neighboring insurance industries but make money in different ways. Baldwin is also the kind of intermediary that sells through to carriers like AFG.

P2.1.text: About Us | American Financial Group, Inc.

P2.2.text: American Financial Group, Inc. is a holding company based in Cincinnati, Ohio and. Our insurance roots go back to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Today, through the operations of Great American Insurance Group, AFG is engaged in property and casualty (P&C) insurance, focusing on specialized commercial products for businesses. We are proud to provide insurance products that help businesses manage their unique financial risks and exposures.

P2.3.text: AFG’s Specialty P&C Group is comprised of over 35 diversified businesses offering a wide range of specialty commercial coverages in three major groupings: Property and Transportation, Specialty Casualty and Specialty Financial.

P2.4.text: Many of our businesses are among the top performers in their respective industries. Our business has entrepreneurial spirit at its core, with a focus on accountability. Business autonomy in our Specialty P&C operations facilitates agility in underwriting, claims and policy servicing, and enables these businesses to develop distribution strategies and relationships in the unique markets they serve.

P2.5.text: By following a consistent, opportunistic strategy over many years and changing economic conditions, we have outperformed market indices over the long term while effectively managing portfolio risk.

P2.6.text: With the power of generations behind it, AFG grows and changes with discipline and integrity. We're proud of who we are, where we've been and where we're going. Our industry is changing, and we continue to change as well.

P2.7.text: American Financial Group traces its history to 1959. In the early days, the Company was known as American Financial Corporation. At its inception, the Company’s principal business consisted of savings and loans. Although insurance and financial services have always been at the core of its businesses, nearly sixty-five years later, the Company has evolved into a holding company with over 35 market-leading insurance operations engaged in the sale of specialty commercial property and casualty (P&C) insurance across a variety of industries.

P2.8.text: Over the past 20 or so years, we have sharpened our focus on the businesses we know best. We’ve done this through carefully selected acquisitions, start-ups, and dispositions of non-core businesses. A sampling of transactions appears below:

P2.11.text: Acquired all minority shares of Great American Financial Resources, Inc.

P2.13.text: Sale of Medicare supplement & critical illness businesses

P2.16.text: Start-up of Great American's Singapore branch

P2.18.text: Start-up of El Aguila Specialty P&C Division

P1.1.text: The Baldwin Group | Insurance & Risk Management

P1.2.text: We offer tailored insurance and risk management solutions for individuals, families & businesses. Empower yourself with peace of mind.

P1.3.text: The Baldwin Group to go private. Read a message from our CEO here.

P1.4.text: Dream boldly, build fearlessly— we’ll help protect it. As a top-ranked national advisory firm, we listen, simplify complexity, and communicate openly to deliver insurance, risk management, benefits, and wealth management solutions tailored to the future you’re creating.

P1.5.text: Reports, headlines, insights, and more—see what’s happening and what it means for you, because staying ahead starts with staying informed.

P1.7.text: A troubled NYC tower reveals how structural surprises and budget overruns are reshaping conversion risk.

P1.9.text: 53% of employees feel overwhelmed by their benefits. See how to turn investment into impact.

P1.11.text: Rising claim severity and shifting coverage availability are influencing how families protect what they’ve built.

P1.12.text: Your goals. Our expertise. Take the next step.

P1.13.text: Personal or business, simple or complex—if you can dream it, we’re ready to protect it.

P1.14.text: Solutions for every chapter of life

P1.15.text: Home, health, wealth, legacy—your life doesn’t fit in a box, so we make sure your protection doesn’t either.

P1.16.text: Insurance needs change as life moves forward—home, auto, Medicare. Protecting it takes coverage built to move with you.

P1.17.text: Establishing your legacy requires deliberate work— collections, valuables, estates. We help you protect it just as intentionally.

P1.18.text: Building wealth takes discipline—investing, retirement, estate planning. Our advisors help you prepare for the long term.

P1.19.text: Solutions built for every stage of growth

P1.20.text: Talent, risk, growth, succession—no two businesses are alike, and neither are the plans we build.

P1.21.text: Growth brings opportunities and new risk exposures. Our specialists prepare you for what’s ahead.

P1.22.text: Top talent expects more than a paycheck. Across health and ancillary solutions, we help you build benefits that keep them engaged.

P1.23.text: A strong retirement plan comes down to the details—design, compliance, fiduciary duty. Our advisors help you get them right.

P1.24.text: A market that won’t sit still

P1.25.text: See how commercial risk, benefits, private risk, and wealth trends shifted at midyear—and what it means for you.

P1.27.text: Every award reflects our commitment to showing up, for our clients and for each other.

P1.28.text: Fortune’s Best Workplaces for Women™ and Fortune’s Best Workplaces for Financial Services™ used under license. Fortune Magazine and Fortune Media (USA) Corporation are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of The Baldwin Group.

P2.2.text: The Baldwin Group: Your trusted partners for insurance advisory services, risk mitigation, employee benefits, and wealth management solutions. Learn more!

P2.3.text: At The Baldwin Group, we translate complex concerns into straightforward, customized solutions to help protect the possible for our clients and enable them to face the future with confidence.​

P2.4.text: The right partners for the right moment

P2.5.text: The Baldwin Group is going private, in partnership with Sequence Holdings and DFO Management, the family investment office of Dell Technologies Founder, Chairman, and CEO Michael Dell. Our vision is unchanged. Our strategy is unchanged. The only thing changing is the capital structure around the firm, and we are changing it because the moment in front of us demands it.

P2.6.text: Every day our clients are pursuing what’s possible, for themselves, their families and their businesses, in a world where risk grows more complex and more connected each year. Our job is to build faster than the risks change. The freedom and the pace this next chapter unlocks will enable us to continue protecting the possibilities our clients are chasing. Read the full message from our CEO.
